reason: A browser plugin that alerts users with synthesized chimes when conversation turns complete or user approval or input is required, with adjustable persisted volume.

summaries.zh: 在对话完成或等待用户审批、选择时播放提示音，并提供可调节且持久化的音量控制。
summaries.en: Plays browser chimes when conversations complete or require user approval or input, with adjustable persistent volume control.

capabilities: Monitors conversation boundary events in the browser
Plays synthesized notification chimes using Web Audio
Provides a volume slider with a persisted local setting
